review_comments: Love seeing this infrastructure work we put in years ago paying dividends :D

just checking: are `PsychSignalSentimentData` members always set in each data point? peaked on some of them and saw a bunch of `0` - if not, thinking if those cases should be skipped/ignored when consolidating? Can follow up offline

PsychSignal data can contain a lot of `0` values, but will always contain at least one value per row of data. This means that the consolidator will always be doing something, and not be consolidating empty data.

Hm given it can contain a lot of 0 values, I'm trying to think of the use case here, user perspective, consider first we get `data.BullIntensity` `1` and afterward we get a bunch of `0s` -> what does the consolidated data, as a `Bar` instance, mean? What's the value in it? 🤔

Data provider specified that 0 values could be a neutral score (information) or a no score/message case (not information, should be skipped), and that we should `differentiate them checking the bull_scored_messages and bear_scored_messages fields to see if the count is "0".`
